start_here: Say to your AI: "Move the word start times of my voice take /Work/demo/take.wav to where the voice really begins, from /Work/demo/take.words.json, writing /Work/demo/take.tight.json." It runs tool:time-words-to-where-the-voice-starts on your computer and writes the new word times.
no_lists_because: It keeps no list of yours: it reads a take and its word times on your computer and writes the word file you name.
instructions: 1. Install python3, numpy and soundfile, and clone the Workshop (git clone https://github.com/Trillion-X/trillion-workshop.git).

2. Your AI reads the row with tools:list and runs its run command on your computer: python3 trillion-workshop/tools/grade-and-repair-speech-audio/do-work/tighten_word_starts.py /Work/demo/take.wav /Work/demo/take.words.json /Work/demo/take.tight.json
3. Use take.tight.json for captions and graphics timed to a word.
